sentence: This project builds sensitive tests that measure chemical marks on HIV RNA in patient samples to study how HIV latency is controlled.
This project studies how a family of transcription factors helps beta cells handle stress and immune tolerance in type 1 diabetes.
This project studies the factors inside and around cancer cells that drive tumor development, progression, metastasis and resistance to treatment.
This project brings together scientists who study how cells and their membranes fuse together.
This project studies how police stop activity relates to suicide-related outcomes among Black youth.
This project studies genes that change how congenital heart disease appears in people with 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, using mouse and zebrafish models.
This project tries to find out how signaling in endothelial cells controls the formation of high endothelial venules.
This project offers imaging instruments and expertise to help researchers design studies and read their results.
This project studies how neurons in the lateral hypothalamic area lead to diet-induced obesity.
This project tests whether the mouse auditory cortex combines sound and behavior signals to detect errors and guide learning.
This project studies how a pathway sets antigen levels on glioblastoma tumor cells so they can be recognized by cell therapy.
This project studies the biology of the visual cascade and the diseases that cause loss of vision.
This project uses cloud computing to speed up ultrasound imaging and therapy simulations for glioblastoma.
This project studies neuroinflammation and remyelination in a viral model of multiple sclerosis.
This project changes chimeric antigen receptor T cells to help them kill solid and liquid tumors.
This project uses cardiac magnetic resonance imaging and injury during cardiopulmonary bypass to predict weaker left ventricular function after surgery for mitral regurgitation.
This project studies how groups of ion channels and the structure of the intercalated disk control electrical signals in heart tissue.
This project uses human stem cell-derived enteric neurons and intestinal organoids to study gut problems linked to autism.
This project adds a laser scanning confocal microscope to study host-parasite interactions, immune responses, agricultural pathogens and environmental pollutants.
This project studies the genes and cell processes behind zebrafish embryo development, birth defects and regeneration.
